test_strategy: Adopt a multi-layered testing strategy covering unit, integration, end-to-end (E2E), performance, and security tests. Use PyTest for unit and integration tests, Locust for load testing, and Postman for API functional validations. Implement automated CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions integrating Databricks and Redis environments in staging. Ensure testing focuses on Feast-based feature registration, Spark job correctness, Redis latency compliance, and proper Unity Catalog access enforcement.

test_cases.title: Feature registration via Python SDK
test_cases.description: Verify that new feature registration succeeds and metadata is correctly stored in the registry.
steps: Call register_feature() in SDK with valid FeatureDefinition parameters
Inspect registry metadata
test_cases.expected_result: Feature is registered, and returned metadata contains lineage and created_at timestamp.

test_cases.title: Feature registration validation error handling
test_cases.description: Ensure SDK registration returns error when required fields missing or invalid.
steps: Call register_feature() with missing owner or invalid version string
test_cases.expected_result: Registration fails with status='error' and appropriate message.

test_cases.title: Batch feature computation trigger
test_cases.description: Verify Databricks Spark job triggers correctly for hourly/daily batch schedule.
steps: POST /api/features/compute with valid feature_group and schedule
Validate job_id generation and status returned
test_cases.expected_result: Job status='scheduled' with valid job_id and output_table provided.

test_cases.title: Real-time feature serving latency test
test_cases.description: Check Redis feature retrieval meets <10ms latency for 50 features.
preconditions: Redis populated with sample feature data
steps: Execute GET /api/serving/realtime with 50 features for one entity
Measure response time

test_cases.title: Training-serving point-in-time join correctness
test_cases.description: Confirm Feast performs temporal joins correctly aligning training event timestamps with historical features.
preconditions: Offline features available in Delta tables
steps: Request historical training data via Feast API with timestamps
Compare retrieved feature values to manually computed expected results
test_cases.expected_result: Feature values correspond exactly to training timestamps eliminating skew.

test_cases.title: Feature drift detection alert generation
test_cases.description: Validate alert triggers when drift exceeds configured threshold.
steps: Simulate drift by altering feature distribution
Check /api/features/monitoring/drift response
test_cases.expected_result: Alert returned with status='drift_detected' and drift_score above threshold.

test_cases.title: Unity Catalog access control enforcement
test_cases.description: Test permissions for feature access based on team role via Unity Catalog.
steps: POST /api/auth/permissions with valid and invalid team roles
Inspect access decision
test_cases.expected_result: Access granted for authorized teams; denied with status='denied' for unauthorized users.

test_cases.title: REST API input validation
test_cases.description: Ensure API rejects malformed requests with 400 status code.
steps: POST /api/features/register with missing tags field
Observe response
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 400 returned and validation error message displayed.

test_cases.title: Parallel request load handling
test_cases.description: Simulate 500 concurrent feature serving requests and verify system stability.
preconditions: Redis and FastAPI deployed in staging environment
steps: Execute parallel GET /api/serving/realtime calls for 500 clients using Locust
Observe latency and throughput
test_cases.expected_result: System handles 500 concurrent requests maintaining <10ms latency and 0 error rate.

test_cases.title: Data encryption and security compliance check
test_cases.description: Validate all data exchanges are encrypted (TLS) between Feast, Redis, and Databricks.
steps: Inspect connection configuration and verify SSL handshake logs
test_cases.expected_result: All connections use TLS with valid certificates.

test_cases.title: SDK – Feature retrieval via REST API consistency test
test_cases.description: Ensure SDK and API return identical feature data and metadata.
preconditions: Feature registered in Feast registry via SDK
steps: Fetch same feature using SDK and GET /api/features/{feature_name}
Compare JSON outputs
test_cases.expected_result: Returned metadata and version fields identical.

test_cases.title: Cost optimization validation
test_cases.description: Confirm feature computation logs show reduced redundant Spark jobs and monthly cost < $25K.
steps: Run daily batch computation workflow
Check Spark job count and Databricks usage metrics
test_cases.expected_result: Total compute cost projection ≤ $25K/month; duplication eliminated.

test_data_requirements: Sample feature definitions with version and lineage metadata
Synthetic transaction and customer datasets for Spark batch jobs
Redis mock data for 100 entities and 50 features each
Unity Catalog user and team role mappings
Drift monitoring thresholds and baseline distributions
Feast registry configuration and Delta tables path
automation_approach: Implement automated test suite using PyTest integrated with GitHub Actions. Use Dockerized test environment including Redis and Databricks Connect mock. Leverage pytest fixtures for SDK and API endpoints. Integrate Locust for load and latency tests executed nightly. Employ Postman/Newman for smoke tests in staging before deployment. Use coverage reports aggregated into CI pipeline and thresholds enforced via code coverage badges.
coverage_goals: Achieve 90% unit test coverage for SDK/core logic, 80% integration coverage across APIs and Databricks workflows, 100% critical path E2E test execution. Validate Redis p99 latency compliance and Unity Catalog permission enforcement. Ensure all user stories covered via mapped test cases with pass rate ≥ 95% before release.
